# KI-130 — Channel store (append-only log)

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/store.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/store.test.ts`

## Outcome

`packages/agent/src/local/store.ts` exports `openLocalStore`. It is the helper's only reader and writer of `<stateRoot>/local/` (except `helper.json` and `helper.log`, which belong to KI-137/KI-136). It returns an object that implements the pinned `LocalStore` interface (contracts L8) over the on-disk layout (L2) and the replay rules (L3):

- each channel is a folder `channels/<roomKey>/` with an append-only `log.jsonl` and an atomically rewritten `secrets.json`;
- every write goes through one in-process queue, so `seq` is strictly increasing, `(sender, txnId)` is deduplicated, and a link is consumed at most once even under concurrent calls;
- reopening the store after a crash or kill rebuilds exactly the same state (members, names, listening modes, links, tokens, summaries) and tolerates a torn last line.

The operator-visible result: channels, history, roster and listening modes survive a helper restart or reboot (AE8, AE12), a consumed or expired link is refused (AE9), and every file is 0700/0600 and passes `ensureStateDir` (AE11). All tests use a temp directory, a fake clock and fake random bytes.

## Context and evidence

- **D2** (single writer of an append-only per-channel log in the khala state dir), **D5** (single-use 10-minute link), **D6** (persist until deleted, no auto-prune). KTD4: "The helper owns `channels/<roomKey>/log.jsonl` (append-only, `seq`, `(sender, txnId)` dedup) and `secrets.json` (hashes only). Replay rebuilds members, names and modes. No locking, no DB."
- AE8 (restart: "history is intact; nothing is lost or replayed as new"), AE9 (link hygiene), AE11 (0700/0600, `ensureStateDir`), AE12 (persistence and delete ends members' streams).
- research-2 §5 "Concurrency and atomicity": a promise-chain queue, one open fd, no fsync per message, torn trailing line dropped like `readEntries`.
- Every route module (KI-132..KI-135) codes against the `LocalStore` interface from KI-110 with fakes; this ticket is the real implementation that KI-137 composes. Route tickets will call exactly the methods below, so behaviour that the interface comments leave open is pinned in **Contract and invariants**.

## Scope

1. `openLocalStore(input)` — open/replay, returns `LocalStore & { close(): Promise<void> }`.
2. All `LocalStore` methods (L8), including the in-memory revision counter and the two waiters.
3. `LocalStoreError` (codes `not_found`, `storage_failed`).
4. `store.test.ts` with the scenarios below.

## Non-goals

- HTTP, guards, cookies, static files: **KI-131**.
- Request validation (channel name length, `txnId` format, message body rules, `checkName` for renames, who may send what): the route modules **KI-132** (agent join), **KI-133** (rooms), **KI-134** (owner channels), **KI-135** (profile). The store trusts its callers' content and only checks that the channel exists.
- Join/leave announcement channel events, agent naming, minting agent user ids and access tokens: **KI-132** / **KI-134** (they call `append` and `setMemberToken`).
- Open tokens, owner cookie sessions, pending joins, `helper.json`, admin token: in memory in **KI-137** (`HelperContext`).
- Computing the default owner profile (`resolveLocalOwnerName`): **KI-122** + **KI-137**; the store receives a ready `OwnerProfile`.
- Wire/record types and decoders (`LocalEvent`, `decodeLocalEvent`, id helpers, constants): **KI-110**. Never redefine them here.
- Pruning anything (D6).

## Contract and invariants

Contracts L2, verbatim:

> `stateRoot` is the existing `stateRoot(env)` from `packages/agent/src/state.ts:22-26` (`$XDG_STATE_HOME/khala` when absolute, else `~/.local/state/khala`). Every directory is created with the existing `ensureStateDir` (`state.ts:37-52`, 0700, rejects symlinks, group/other bits and foreign uids); every JSON file is written with the existing `writeJsonAtomic` (`state.ts:58-77`, 0600).
>
> ```text
> <stateRoot>/
>   hosted-profile.json                 0600  {"v":1,"username":"kevin","savedAt":"…"}   written by the agent on a hosted connect (KI-122); read-only for the helper
>   local/                              0700
>     helper.json                       0600  L11 HelperFile; written only by the running helper
>     helper.log                        0600  helper stderr/stdout (no message bodies, no tokens)
>     owner.json                        0600  L7 OwnerProfile
>     channels/<roomKey>/               0700  roomKey = roomId without the leading "!" and the ":local" suffix
>       log.jsonl                       0600  L3 LocalEvent, one per line, append-only
>       secrets.json                    0600  L3 ChannelSecrets (hashes only), rewritten atomically
> ```
>
> - The helper is the **only** writer of everything under `local/`. Agents' MCP processes stay the only writers of their own session directories (`<stateRoot>/<harness>/<sessionId>/`, unchanged).
> - On start the store replays `log.jsonl`; a torn last line (no trailing `\n` or invalid JSON) is ignored and truncated away before the next append, the same tolerance as `readEntries` (`packages/agent/src/inbox.ts:12-19`).
> - Deleting a channel removes `channels/<roomKey>/` recursively. Nothing is pruned automatically (D6).

Contracts L3, verbatim (constants, ids, events, secrets):

```ts
export const LOCAL_SERVER_NAME = 'local' as const;
export const LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID = '@khala_owner:local' as const;       // the one human; display name = OwnerProfile.username
export const LOCAL_DEFAULT_PORT = 47830;
export const LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS = 600_000;                                // single-use share link and open link lifetime (D5)
export const LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S = 25;
export const LOCAL_IDLE_EXIT_MS = 600_000;                               // helper exits after 10 min with no request and no open long-poll (D2)
export const LOCAL_TOKEN_BYTES = 32;                                     // 43 base64url chars

export const newLocalRoomId = (random16: Uint8Array): string => `!${Buffer.from(random16).toString('base64url')}:local`;   // 22 chars + suffix
export const localRoomKey = (roomId: string): string => roomId.slice(1, -':local'.length);
export const newLocalAgentUserId = (random4: Uint8Array): string => `@agent-${Buffer.from(random4).toString('hex')}:local`;
export const newLocalEventId = (random16: Uint8Array): string => `$${Buffer.from(random16).toString('base64url')}`;
export const isLocalRoomId = (value: string): boolean => /^![A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}:local$/u.test(value);

export type LocalEventType = 'm.room.create' | 'm.room.name' | 'm.room.member' | 'm.room.message'
  | 'com.khala.event.v1' | 'com.khala.listening_mode.v1';

export type LocalEvent = {
  seq: number;                 // 1-based, strictly increasing per channel, assigned by the helper
  eventId: string;             // "$<22 base64url>"
  roomId: string;              // "!<22 base64url>:local"
  type: LocalEventType;
  sender: string;              // LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID or "@agent-<8 hex>:local"
  ts: number;                  // helper clock, ms since epoch
  txnId?: string;              // present when the sender supplied one; (sender, txnId) is unique per channel
  content: Record<string, unknown>;
};

// content by type
export type LocalCreateContent = { name: string; createdBy: string };                       // m.room.create (seq 1)
export type LocalNameContent = { name: string };                                            // m.room.name
export type LocalMemberContent = {                                                          // m.room.member
  user: string; membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave';
  displayname: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent';
  harness?: 'claude' | 'codex'; invitedBy?: string;
  'com.khala.listening_mode'?: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async';
};
// m.room.message content: { msgtype: 'm.text', body: string }                 (body 1..8000 chars, as khala_send)
// com.khala.event.v1 content: ChannelEventContent from '@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event' (encoded by encodeChannelEvent)
// com.khala.listening_mode.v1 content: ListeningModeCommandContent from '@khala/contracts/m1/listening-mode' ({v:1, agent, mode}); sender must be LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID

export type ChannelSecrets = {
  v: 1;
  links: Record<string, { expiresAt: string; consumedAt?: string; kind: 'join' }>;           // key = sha256(token) hex
  members: Record<string, { tokenSha256: string }>;                                          // key = user id; the owner has no entry (cookie auth)
};

export function decodeLocalEvent(input: unknown): Decoded<LocalEvent>;     // strict: unknown keys fail
```

Contracts L3 derived state, verbatim (this ticket owns these rules):

> - Members = the last `m.room.member` per `content.user`. A member is **present** when its membership is `invite` or `join`.
> - Display names come only from member events. A rename is a new member event with the same membership and a new `displayname`, sent by the owner.
> - Listening mode of an agent = `content['com.khala.listening_mode']` of its last member event, else `sync` (`DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE`, `packages/contracts/src/m1/listening-mode.ts:8`). The agent writes it (echo after applying an owner command), exactly like the Matrix member-state echo (`packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts` `publishListeningMode`).
> - Channel name = the last `m.room.name` content, else the create content.

Contracts L5 member shape, verbatim (what `members()` returns):

```ts
export type LocalHistoryPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; nextBefore?: string };   // m.room.message + com.khala.event.v1 only, oldest first, strictly older than `before`; nextBefore = oldest eventId when older ones exist
export type LocalMember = {
  userId: string;                    // "@khala_owner:local" | "@agent-<8hex>:local"; the web uses it as Participant.matrixUserId
  participantId: string;             // = userId (the web's ParticipantId)
  ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID;    // every member belongs to the one owner
  deviceId: string;                  // agents "KH_LOCAL_<8hex>", the owner LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID; the web's authorDeviceId
  displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex';
  ownerLabel?: string;               // agents: the owner's username (Participant.ownerLabel)
  membership: 'invite' | 'join';
  listeningMode?: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async';   // agents only; DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE when never echoed
};
export const LOCAL_OWNER_ID = 'local-owner' as const;             // the web's OwnerId / AuthPrincipal.ownerId
export const LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID = 'KH_LOCAL_OWNER' as const;
```

Contracts L6 summary shape, verbatim:

```ts
export type LocalChannelsPage = { revision: number; channels: LocalChannelSummary[] };   // revision: helper-wide counter bumped on every append/create/delete (in memory; restarts at 0)
export type LocalChannelSummary = {
  roomId: string; name: string; createdAt: string; lastSeq: number; lastTs: number;
  preview: string | null;                                  // body of the latest m.room.message (m.text), else null
  lastSender?: { userId: string; displayName: string };    // sender of that message
  members: { userId: string; displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex' }[];   // present members, owner first
};
// POST   /api/local/channels           body {name, operationId?} → LocalChannelCreated   (name 1..64 chars, trimmed; appends create + owner join; operationId 1..64 [A-Za-z0-9._-] is stored in the create content and is idempotent)
```

Contracts L7, verbatim:

```ts
export type OwnerProfile = { v: 1; username: string; color: HumanColorId; initials?: string; updatedAt: string };   // <stateRoot>/local/owner.json
```
> - First helper start with no `owner.json`: `username = resolveLocalOwnerName(env)` (L10); `color = defaultHumanColor(LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID)` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/colors.ts:19-21`).
> - `username` obeys `checkName(name,'username')` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/names.ts:18-26`). `initials` (when present) obeys the same rule as the hosted initials work in flight (PR #986); until that merges, 1–2 letters `[A-Za-z]`.

Contracts L8 `LocalStore`, verbatim:

```ts
export interface LocalStore {
  listChannels(): LocalChannelSummary[];                                   // newest activity first
  channelSummary(roomId: string): LocalChannelSummary | undefined;
  createChannel(name: string, operationId?: string): Promise<{ roomId: string; created: boolean }>;   // same operationId → same roomId, created:false
  findByOperation(operationId: string): string | undefined;
  deleteChannel(roomId: string): Promise<void>;
  hasChannel(roomId: string): boolean;
  channelOfMember(userId: string): string | undefined;                     // agent user ids are unique across channels
  revision(): number;                                                      // bumped on every append/create/delete
  waitForRevision(since: number, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;   // resolves when revision() !== since, on timeout, or on abort
  append(roomId: string, input: { type: LocalEventType; sender: string; content: Record<string, unknown>; txnId?: string }): Promise<LocalEvent>;   // dedups (sender, txnId)
  eventsAfter(roomId: string, after: number, limit: number): LocalEvent[];
  waitForEvent(roomId: string, after: number, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;   // resolves when lastSeq > after, on timeout, or on abort
  history(roomId: string, before: string | undefined, limit: number): LocalHistoryPage;
  members(roomId: string): LocalMember[];
  member(roomId: string, userId: string): (LocalMember & { membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave' }) | undefined;
  channelName(roomId: string): string;
  mintLink(roomId: string, kind: 'join'): Promise<{ token: string; expiresAt: string }>;   // returns plaintext once; stores sha256
  consumeLink(token: string): Promise<{ roomId: string } | null>;                           // atomic single use; null if unknown/used/expired
  setMemberToken(roomId: string, userId: string, tokenSha256: string | null): Promise<void>;
  agentForToken(token: string): { roomId: string; userId: string } | null;                 // timing-safe compare over sha256
  owner(): OwnerProfile;
  setOwner(next: OwnerProfile): Promise<void>;
}
```

### This ticket's pinned additions (KI-137 and the tests consume them exactly)

```ts
// packages/agent/src/local/store.ts
export class LocalStoreError extends Error {
  readonly code: 'not_found' | 'storage_failed';
  constructor(code: LocalStoreError['code']) { super(code); this.name = 'LocalStoreError'; this.code = code; }
}
export type OpenLocalStoreInput = {
  root: string;                              // <stateRoot>/local (absolute)
  ownerDefault: OwnerProfile;                // used when owner.json is missing or invalid; NOT written at open (see invariant 3)
  now?: () => number;                        // default Date.now
  random?: (bytes: number) => Uint8Array;    // default crypto.randomBytes
};
export type OpenedLocalStore = LocalStore & { close(): Promise<void> };   // close: drain the queue, close every log handle, resolve every waiter
export function openLocalStore(input: OpenLocalStoreInput): Promise<OpenedLocalStore>;
```

### Invariants

1. **Directories.** Call `ensureStateDir(path.join(root, 'channels'))` once at open and `ensureStateDir(path.join(root, 'channels', key))` before creating a channel. **Never call `ensureStateDir(root)` itself**: `ensureStateDir(dir)` checks `dirname(dirname(dir))`, `dirname(dir)` and `dir` (`packages/agent/src/state.ts:40`), so for `root = <stateRoot>/local` it would check `$XDG_STATE_HOME` / `~/.local/state`, which is commonly `0755` on real machines and would throw `unsafe_state_dir` in production while temp-dir tests pass. `ensureStateDir('<root>/channels')` checks `<stateRoot>`, `<stateRoot>/local` and `channels` — exactly the Khala-owned levels. A `StateError` becomes `LocalStoreError('storage_failed')` (keep the `unsafe_state_dir` case distinguishable by rethrowing the `StateError` itself at open — see step 2).
2. **Files.** `log.jsonl` is opened with `fs.open(file, 'a', 0o600)` (O_APPEND|O_CREAT|O_WRONLY), one handle per channel, kept open until delete/close. `secrets.json` and `owner.json` are only ever written with `writeJsonAtomic`. No other file is created under `root`.
3. **Open performs no file writes** (directory creation aside). Reason: a second `khala local serve` racing for the port opens the store before it learns it lost the bind (L11); it must not touch the live helper's files. Concretely: the torn tail is truncated lazily inside the queue right before that channel's next append; a missing/invalid `owner.json` is served from `ownerDefault` in memory and persisted by KI-137 after it owns the port (KI-137 calls `setOwner(owner())`).
4. **One write queue.** Every mutating method (`createChannel`, `deleteChannel`, `append`, `mintLink`, `consumeLink`, `setMemberToken`, `setOwner`) runs inside one store-wide promise chain. In-memory state is updated only after the disk write succeeds, so a failed write leaves memory consistent with disk. A rejected task does not break the chain for later tasks.
5. **`seq` and dedup.** `seq = lastSeq + 1` per channel. When `input.txnId` is present and `(sender, txnId)` already exists in that channel, `append` returns the **original** `LocalEvent` (same `eventId`, `seq`, `ts`) and writes nothing and bumps nothing. The dedup index is rebuilt by replay.
6. **Event ids.** `eventId = newLocalEventId(random(16))`; `roomId = newLocalRoomId(random(16))`, regenerated while `hasChannel` or the folder exists.
7. **Revision.** Starts at `0` on every open (in memory). `+1` per stored event (`append`, each of the two events written by `createChannel`), `+1` per `deleteChannel`, `+1` per `setOwner` (the owner's display name appears in every summary; without this bump the browser's channel list long-poll would not refresh after a username change — reported to the planner as an L6 wording fix). A deduplicated `append` does not bump.
8. **Waiters** (`waitForRevision`, `waitForEvent`) never reject. They resolve immediately when the condition already holds, when `signal.aborted`, or (for `waitForEvent`) when the channel does not exist. Otherwise they resolve on the first of: condition met, timeout, abort, channel deleted, store closed. On resolution they clear their timer, remove their abort listener and leave the waiter set. No timer or listener survives a resolved waiter.
9. **Links.** `mintLink` → `token = base64url(random(LOCAL_TOKEN_BYTES))` (43 chars; `base64url` from `@khala/contracts/m1/local`), key `sha256(token)` hex, `expiresAt = new Date(now() + LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS).toISOString()`, persisted in that channel's `secrets.json` before resolving. `consumeLink(token)`: `null` unless token matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/`, the hash exists in a channel that still exists, `consumedAt` is absent and `Date.parse(expiresAt) > now()`; otherwise sets `consumedAt = new Date(now()).toISOString()`, writes `secrets.json`, then returns `{ roomId }`. Expired links are left as they are (no pruning). The plaintext token is never stored or logged.
10. **Member tokens.** `setMemberToken(roomId, userId, sha)` sets `secrets.members[userId] = { tokenSha256: sha }` (or deletes the entry for `null`) and rewrites `secrets.json`. `agentForToken(token)` computes `sha256(token)` and compares it with **every** stored `tokenSha256` using `crypto.timingSafeEqual` over 32-byte buffers (no early exit by map lookup); it returns `{ roomId, userId }` for a match regardless of the member's current membership (routes decide `403 not_member` from `member()`), else `null`. Never accepts the owner (the owner has no entry).
11. **Derived state** follows the L3 rules above, plus these pins:
    - Owner display name everywhere (members, summaries, `lastSender`) is the live `owner().username`, not the `displayname` stored in the owner's member event.
    - Agent `deviceId` = `LOCAL_AGENT_DEVICE_PREFIX + <the 8 hex of its user id>` (e.g. `@agent-a1b2c3d4:local` → `KH_LOCAL_a1b2c3d4`). KI-132 mints the device id the same way (its step 7).
    - Agent `ownerLabel` = `owner().username`; agent `listeningMode` = `memberListeningMode(lastMemberContent)`. The owner has no `harness`, `ownerLabel` or `listeningMode` keys (omit, not `undefined`).
    - `members()` = present members, owner first, then agents in order of their first member event `seq`.
    - `channelOfMember(userId)` = the channel of an agent's last member event (any membership); `undefined` for the owner and unknown ids.
12. **`createChannel(name, operationId?)`**: when `operationId` is given and already known → `{ roomId: existing, created: false }` with no write. Otherwise, in one queue task: create the folder, then append seq 1 `m.room.create` `{ name, createdBy: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, ...(operationId ? { operationId } : {}) }` and seq 2 `m.room.member` `{ user: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, membership: 'join', displayname: owner().username, kind: 'human' }`, both with sender `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`, then `writeJsonAtomic(secrets, { v: 1, links: {}, members: {} })`. **The store appends the owner join; KI-134 must not append it again.** `name` is stored as given (KI-134 trims/validates).
13. **`deleteChannel(roomId)`**: unknown → resolves (no-op, no bump). Otherwise in the queue: close the handle, `fs.rm(dir, { recursive: true, force: true })`, drop every index entry (events, members, tokens, links, operation id), bump revision, resolve that channel's event waiters and all revision waiters.
14. **Reads** for an unknown `roomId`: `channelSummary`/`member` → `undefined`; `members`/`eventsAfter` → `[]`; `history` → `{ events: [] }`; `channelName` → `''`. **Writes** for an unknown `roomId` (`append`, `mintLink`, `setMemberToken`) reject with `LocalStoreError('not_found')`.
15. **`history(roomId, before, limit)`**: candidates = events of type `m.room.message` or `com.khala.event.v1`. With `before`: find that `eventId` in the channel's full log (any type); unknown → `{ events: [] }`; keep candidates with `seq` lower than it. Take the newest `limit` of those, return them oldest first; `nextBefore` = the first returned `eventId` when older candidates remain, else omitted.
16. **`eventsAfter(roomId, after, limit)`**: events with `seq > after`, ascending, at most `limit`.
17. **`listChannels()`**: summaries sorted by `lastTs` desc, then `lastSeq` desc, then `roomId` asc. `createdAt` = ISO of the create event `ts`. `preview` = `content.body` of the latest `m.room.message` whose `content.msgtype === 'm.text'` and `typeof body === 'string'`, else `null`; `lastSender` only when `preview` is not null.
18. **Replay** (open): for each entry of `<root>/channels` whose name matches `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{22}$/` and is a directory: `ensureStateDir` it, read `log.jsonl` (missing → skip the folder entirely, it is not a channel), split on `\n`; the last element is the torn tail when the file does not end with `\n` — remember the byte length up to and including the last `\n` as `validBytes`. Each complete line: `JSON.parse` + `decodeLocalEvent`; keep it only when it decodes, its `roomId` equals `'!' + key + ':local'` and its `seq` is greater than the previous kept `seq`; skip anything else. A channel whose first kept event is not `m.room.create` is skipped (not listed). Then read `secrets.json` with `readJson` + `decodeChannelSecrets` (missing/invalid → `{ v: 1, links: {}, members: {} }`). Read `owner.json` with `readJson` + `decodeOwnerProfile`; missing/invalid → `ownerDefault`. Folder names are checked with `isLocalRoomId('!' + name + ':local')` before use (KI-110's `localRoomKey` throws on non-local ids).
19. **No logging** of message bodies, tokens or token hashes. The store does not log at all.

### Worked example

Input: the L3 worked `log.jsonl` (7 events in `channels/c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw/`), a `secrets.json` of

```json
{"v":1,"links":{"0f007385b6f9d4b7eeb2748605afe1a984a0a3bfa3f014d09e2a784ce9e5cd1a":{"expiresAt":"2025-10-02T09:10:01.000Z","kind":"join"}},"members":{"@agent-a1b2c3d4:local":{"tokenSha256":"<64 hex>"}}}
```

(`0f00…cd1a` is `sha256("AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA")`, the 43-char token of 43 `A`s), and `owner.json` `{"v":1,"username":"kevin","color":"teal","updatedAt":"2025-10-02T09:00:00.000Z"}`. After `openLocalStore({ root, ownerDefault, now: () => 1759395900000 })`:

```ts
store.channelName('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local')            // 'refactor'
store.members('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local')
// [ { userId:'@khala_owner:local', participantId:'@khala_owner:local', ownerId:'local-owner', deviceId:'KH_LOCAL_OWNER',
//     displayName:'kevin', kind:'human', membership:'join' },
//   { userId:'@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', participantId:'@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', ownerId:'local-owner', deviceId:'KH_LOCAL_a1b2c3d4',
//     displayName:'kevin-Claude', kind:'agent', harness:'claude', ownerLabel:'kevin', membership:'join', listeningMode:'steer' } ]
store.channelSummary('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local')
// { roomId:'!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local', name:'refactor', createdAt:'2025-10-02T09:00:01.000Z', lastSeq:7, lastTs:1759395801000,
//   preview:'@kevin-Codex can you review PR #12?', lastSender:{ userId:'@khala_owner:local', displayName:'kevin' },
//   members:[ { userId:'@khala_owner:local', displayName:'kevin', kind:'human' },
//             { userId:'@agent-a1b2c3d4:local', displayName:'kevin-Claude', kind:'agent', harness:'claude' } ] }
store.revision()                                                // 0 (fresh process)
store.history('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local', undefined, 50)  // { events: [<seq 5 message>] }
store.channelOfMember('@agent-a1b2c3d4:local')                  // '!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local'
await store.append('!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local', { type:'m.room.message', sender:'@khala_owner:local', txnId:'web-7b1e', content:{ msgtype:'m.text', body:'dup' } })
// returns the stored seq-5 event unchanged ($d4…, body '@kevin-Codex can you review PR #12?'); file unchanged; revision still 0
await store.consumeLink('AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')   // { roomId:'!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local' } (now < expiresAt)
await store.consumeLink('AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA')   // null
```

(In the test fixture, replace the `$a1…`-style abbreviated event ids of the L3 example with full 22-char base64url ids so `decodeLocalEvent` accepts them.)

### Steps

1. **Module skeleton.** Imports: `node:fs/promises`, `node:fs` (`constants` only if needed), `node:path`, `node:crypto` (`createHash`, `randomBytes`, `timingSafeEqual`); `ensureStateDir`, `readJson`, `writeJsonAtomic`, `StateError` from `../state`; `memberListeningMode` from `@khala/contracts/m1/listening-mode`; the KI-110 names (including `decodeOwnerProfile`, `decodeChannelSecrets`, `base64url`, `LOCAL_AGENT_DEVICE_PREFIX`) from `@khala/contracts/m1/local`; `import type { LocalStore, … }` from `./types`. No other import. `const sha256hex = (s: string) => createHash('sha256').update(s).digest('hex')`.
2. **State per channel** (a private `Channel` record): `roomId`, `key`, `dir`, `events: LocalEvent[]`, `byEventId: Map<string, LocalEvent>`, `byTxn: Map<string, LocalEvent>` (key `${sender}\u0000${txnId}`), `lastMember: Map<string, { event: LocalEvent; firstSeq: number }>`, `name`, `operationId?`, `secrets: ChannelSecrets`, `handle?: FileHandle`, `validBytes?: number` (set when a torn tail was seen), `waiters: Set<() => void>`. Store-level: `channels: Map<roomId, Channel>`, `operations: Map<operationId, roomId>`, `agentChannel: Map<userId, roomId>`, `revision`, `revisionWaiters: Set<() => void>`, `owner: OwnerProfile`, `queue: Promise<unknown>`, `closed`.
   Open: `try { await ensureStateDir(path.join(root,'channels')) } catch (e) { throw e }` (let `StateError` propagate so KI-137 can print `unsafe_state_dir`), then replay per invariant 18 with `fs.readdir(…, { withFileTypes: true })`, reading each log with `fs.readFile(file)` as a `Buffer` (compute `validBytes` as `buffer.lastIndexOf(0x0a) + 1`).
3. **Queue.** `function enqueue<T>(task: () => Promise<T>): Promise<T> { const run = queue.then(task, task); queue = run.catch(() => undefined); return run; }`. After `close()` starts, `enqueue` rejects with `LocalStoreError('storage_failed')`.
4. **`writeEvent(channel, input)`** (only called inside the queue): build `LocalEvent` `{ seq, eventId, roomId, type, sender, ts: now(), ...(txnId ? { txnId } : {}), content }`; if `channel.validBytes !== undefined` → `await fs.truncate(logPath, channel.validBytes)` and clear it; open the handle lazily (`fs.open(logPath, 'a', 0o600)`); `await handle.write(JSON.stringify(event) + '\n')`; on any error throw `LocalStoreError('storage_failed')` before touching memory; then index it (events, maps, `lastMember` when `type === 'm.room.member'` → also `agentChannel` for agent users, `name` for `m.room.name`), bump revision, fire waiters (`channel.waiters` and `revisionWaiters`: call and clear).
5. **`append`** = `enqueue(async () => { channel or throw not_found; dedup check; return writeEvent(...) })`. Do the dedup check **inside** the queue so two concurrent identical sends produce one event.
6. **`createChannel`, `deleteChannel`, `mintLink`, `consumeLink`, `setMemberToken`, `setOwner`** per invariants 9, 10, 12, 13. Each persists (`writeJsonAtomic`) before mutating memory: write a copy of the secrets object, then assign it. `setOwner(next)` → `writeJsonAtomic(path.join(root,'owner.json'), next)`, then `owner = next`, bump revision.
7. **Waiters.** One helper:
   ```ts
   function waitUntil(ready: () => boolean, set: Set<() => void>, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void> {
     if (ready() || signal.aborted || closed) return Promise.resolve();
     return new Promise(resolve => {
       const done = () => { clearTimeout(timer); signal.removeEventListener('abort', done); set.delete(done); resolve(); };
       const timer = setTimeout(done, Math.max(0, timeoutMs));
       signal.addEventListener('abort', done, { once: true });
       set.add(done);
     });
   }
   ```
   `waitForRevision(since, …)` = `waitUntil(() => revision !== since, revisionWaiters, …)`. `waitForEvent(roomId, after, …)`: unknown channel → resolve; else `waitUntil(() => !channels.has(roomId) || lastSeq > after, channel.waiters, …)`. Firing a set: copy to an array, then call each (each `done` removes itself).
8. **Reads** per invariants 11, 14–17. Build `LocalMember` objects fresh on each call (callers may mutate them). Omit optional keys instead of setting `undefined` (tests use `toEqual` with the exact object; `toStrictEqual` in one test).
9. **`close()`**: `closed = true`; await the queue; close every handle; fire every waiter set. Idempotent.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/local/store.test.ts` (vitest; temp root from `fs.mkdtemp(path.join(os.tmpdir(), 'khala-store-'))`, `root = path.join(tmp, 'khala', 'local')`; fake `now` from a mutable `let clock = 1_759_395_600_000`; fake `random(n)` returning bytes from an incrementing counter so ids are deterministic and distinct; `ownerDefault = { v: 1, username: 'kevin', color: 'teal', updatedAt: '2025-10-02T09:00:00.000Z' }`; `afterEach` closes the store and removes `tmp`).

1. **Create.** `createChannel('refactor')` → `{ roomId, created: true }`, `isLocalRoomId(roomId)`; `eventsAfter(roomId, 0, 10)` has seq 1 `m.room.create` `{ name:'refactor', createdBy:'@khala_owner:local' }` and seq 2 owner join member event with `displayname:'kevin'`; `revision()` is `2`; `listChannels()` has one summary with `members` = owner only and `preview: null`; `secrets.json` parses to `{ v:1, links:{}, members:{} }`.
2. **operationId idempotency.** `createChannel('a','op-1')` twice → same roomId, second `created:false`, one folder on disk, `findByOperation('op-1')` = roomId, create content includes `operationId:'op-1'`; after reopen `findByOperation('op-1')` still resolves.
3. **Replay equivalence (AE8).** Build: create; invite agent `@agent-a1b2c3d4:local` (owner sender, `invitedBy`); agent join with mode `sync`; owner message with `txnId:'web-1'`; owner `com.khala.listening_mode.v1`; agent re-join echo with `steer`; owner rename (member event, new `displayname:'kev-bot'`); a `m.room.name` to `refactor-2`; `setMemberToken`; `mintLink`. Snapshot `listChannels()`, `members()`, `member()` for both users, `eventsAfter(r,0,200)`, `history(r,undefined,100)`, `channelName`, `channelOfMember`, `agentForToken(plain)`. `close()`, reopen with the same root → every snapshot `toEqual` the old one; `revision()` is `0`.
4. **Worked example fixture.** Write the worked-example files by hand (full-length ids), open → exactly the values in **Worked example**, including `deviceId:'KH_LOCAL_a1b2c3d4'`, `listeningMode:'steer'`, owner first, `lastSender.displayName:'kevin'`.
5. **Dedup.** `append` the same `(sender, txnId)` twice concurrently via `Promise.all` → both results `toStrictEqual` the same event; the log has one line for it; revision bumped once. Same `txnId` from a different sender → a new event.
6. **Torn line.** Append 3 events, close, append the raw bytes `{"seq":4,"eventId":"$x` (no newline) to `log.jsonl`. Reopen → `eventsAfter(r,0,10)` has 3 events and the file is **byte-identical** after open (no write at open). `append` one event → seq `4`, the file now has exactly 4 lines that each `JSON.parse`, and reopening yields 4 events. A complete-but-invalid middle line (`not json\n`) is skipped and later lines still load.
7. **Open performs no writes.** With no `owner.json`, open → `owner()` equals `ownerDefault` and `owner.json` does not exist; `setOwner(owner())` creates it with mode `0o600`.
8. **Link single use under concurrency (AE9).** `mintLink` → token 43 chars `/^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{43}$/`; `secrets.json` contains `sha256(token)` hex and not the token; `Promise.all([consumeLink(t), consumeLink(t)])` → exactly one `{ roomId }` and one `null`; after reopen `consumeLink(t)` → `null`.
9. **Expiry.** Mint at `clock`; set `clock += LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS` → `consumeLink` → `null` (boundary: `expiresAt` not strictly greater than now). Mint again, `clock += LOCAL_LINK_TTL_MS - 1` → `{ roomId }`. `consumeLink('short')`, an unknown 43-char token → `null`.
10. **Tokens.** `setMemberToken(r, agent, sha256hex(t))` → `agentForToken(t)` = `{ roomId:r, userId:agent }`; `agentForToken('x'.repeat(43))` → `null`; after the agent's leave member event `agentForToken(t)` still returns the mapping and `member(r, agent).membership` is `'leave'` and `members(r)` excludes it; `setMemberToken(r, agent, null)` → `null`.
11. **Delete (AE12).** Start `waitForEvent(r, lastSeq, 10_000, signal)` and `waitForRevision(rev, 10_000, signal)`; `deleteChannel(r)` → both resolve promptly; the folder is gone (`fs.stat` rejects `ENOENT`); `hasChannel(r)` false; `append(r, …)` rejects `{ code: 'not_found' }`; `channelOfMember(agent)` → `undefined`; a link minted for `r` → `consumeLink` `null`; reopen → not listed.
12. **Permissions (AE11).** After create + mint + `setOwner`: `<tmp>/khala`, `root`, `root/channels`, the channel folder are `0o700`; `log.jsonl`, `secrets.json`, `owner.json` are `0o600` (`(await fs.stat(p)).mode & 0o777`). **Production layout:** with `tmp` itself chmod `0o755` (simulating `~/.local/state`), `openLocalStore` still succeeds. With `root/channels` chmod `0o755` → open rejects with a `StateError` whose `code` is `unsafe_state_dir`.
13. **Revision and wait semantics.** `waitForRevision(revision(), 50, signal)` resolves after ~50 ms with no change; with a pending append it resolves before the timeout; `waitForRevision(revision() - 1, …)` resolves immediately; an already-aborted signal resolves immediately; aborting mid-wait resolves. `waitForEvent(r, lastSeq-1, …)` resolves immediately; `waitForEvent('!unknownunknownunknown0:local', …)` resolves immediately. **No leaks:** after each waiter resolves, `getEventListeners(signal, 'abort')` (from `node:events`) is empty, and with `vi.useFakeTimers()` `vi.getTimerCount()` is `0`.
14. **History paging.** 5 messages + 1 channel event + member events: `history(r, undefined, 2)` → the 2 newest candidates oldest first with `nextBefore` = first returned id; follow `nextBefore` until it is absent; the union equals all 6 candidates in order, no member events; unknown `before` → `{ events: [] }`.
15. **Ordering of `listChannels()`.** Two channels; a message in the older one moves it first.
16. **Owner display name.** `setOwner({ ...owner(), username:'kev' })` bumps revision; `members(r)[0].displayName` and the summary owner entry become `'kev'`; agent `ownerLabel` becomes `'kev'`.
17. **Storage failure.** Make the channel folder read-only (`0o500`) after the handle is closed and before the first `mintLink` → rejects `{ code: 'storage_failed' }`; `consumeLink` of an earlier token still works after restoring `0o700` (the queue was not poisoned).

Mutation checks (the worker must confirm each of these fails at least one test when introduced, then revert): move the dedup check outside the queue (scenario 5 fails); truncate at open instead of before the next append (scenario 6 "byte-identical" fails); set `consumedAt` after `writeJsonAtomic` resolves but check it before awaiting outside the queue (scenario 8 fails); drop the `clearTimeout` in `done` (scenario 13 timer count fails). The timing-safe scan in `agentForToken` is a review item, not a test item: reviewers check it compares against every stored hash with `timingSafeEqual`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `openLocalStore` and `LocalStoreError` exported with the pinned signatures; the returned object satisfies `LocalStore` from `./types` (KI-110) with no cast.
- [ ] Every scenario 1–17 passes; the four mutation checks were tried and each was caught.
- [ ] Only Node built-ins, `../state` and `@khala/contracts/m1/*` are imported; no new dependency; no file outside `<root>` touched; nothing logged.
- [ ] `ensureStateDir` is never called on `root` itself (grep).
- [ ] Open writes no file (scenario 6, 7).

## Risks and stop conditions

- **Stop** if KI-110's `packages/agent/src/local/types.ts` or `packages/contracts/src/m1/local.ts` differ from the L3/L5/L8 blocks above (names, field names, method signatures). Do not define substitutes.
- `member()`: KI-110 lands it as `(Omit<LocalMember, 'membership'> & { membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave' }) | undefined` (the L8 intersection collapses to `'invite' | 'join'`). Implement that type. **Stop** if the landed type still cannot represent `'leave'`; do not cast around it.
- KI-110 adds `operationId?: string` to `LocalCreateContent`; **stop** if `decodeLocalEvent` rejects a create event carrying `operationId`.
- KI-134's create route appends the owner join only when `member(roomId, LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID)?.membership !== 'join'` (its D-b), so this store appending it (invariant 12) yields exactly one owner join. KI-134's remove keeps the agent token (its D-a), matching invariant 10.
- If the sibling route tickets (KI-132..KI-135) landed first and append the owner join themselves after `createChannel`, or derive agent device ids differently from invariant 11, report the mismatch to the Executor rather than changing their files.
- Large logs are fully held in memory (MVP, D6). Do not add pruning, compaction or indexes on disk.

## Complexity rationale

3: a concurrency-sensitive single-writer store (queue, lazy torn-tail truncation, atomic single-use links, timing-safe token scan, leak-free waiters) plus deterministic replay. No HTTP and no new dependency, but many exact semantics consumed by four sibling tickets.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
